vpn.title: How Rayn VPN works
vpn.whyBody: Rayn VPN uses your device's VPN service to establish an encrypted tunnel and route your internet traffic through the server location you select, helping protect your connection on untrusted networks.
vpn.dataBody: To route your connection, the VPN service can access your device's network traffic. This access exists only to carry your traffic through the tunnel.
vpn.trafficBody: Your traffic is forwarded only to the server you choose. We do not log, inspect, store, or sell the contents of your traffic or your browsing activity, and it is never shared with third parties.
vpn.consent: By tapping Agree & Continue, you consent to the use of the VPN service as described above.

data.title: Your account data
data.accountBody: To sign you in and manage your subscription, we collect your email address, account identifier, and subscription status.
data.passwordBody: Your password is used only to authenticate you. It is never stored on your device in readable form.
data.useBody: This information is used only to authenticate you and manage your subscription. It is not sold, and it is not shared with third parties for their own use.
data.consent: By tapping Agree & Continue, you consent to this collection as described in our Privacy Policy.
